description: Records a pass holder's own yes or no to a meetup the organizer announced on the event pass ("yes, I will be at the bar", "no, I cannot make the meetup"). Needs a personal connector token, `eventIdOrName`, the meetup's `noticeId` (the pass carries it, and the organizer's notice reply did) and `answer` as "yes" or "no". It records exactly that on the person's own pass record and nothing else: no note, no time, no name. The organizer can then send a notice to everybody who said yes. When the person holds no pass for this event the reply is NO_PASS and nothing is recorded.

answer.description: REQUIRED. "yes" they are coming, "no" they are not. Nothing else is recorded.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or name.

noticeId.description: REQUIRED. The noticeId of the meetup notice being answered, as the pass or the organizer gave it.

name: event_meetup_rsvp
title: Answer a meetup notice (yes or no)
